info.title: Palimpsest
info.description: Play Palimpsest, a text adventure Claude wrote for AIs. Each call is one move (or several, separated by semicolons).

get.summary: Start a new game (omit r) or make a move in an existing one.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Your reader_key from the first response. Omit only to start a brand-new reader.

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: The game command, e.g. 'look', 'n', 'examine plaque', 'say cinder', 'enter 924'. Chain several with semicolons.
